title: Diagram Interpretation Tool: a plain-language overview (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Diagram Interpretation Tool does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature diagram reader treats every diagram as a permanent record: each shape it finds is stamped with its position, each label with its text, each arrow with its direction. Uncertain readings are marked uncertain, never guessed. The graph it builds carries the evidence with it.
demo:
# Diagram Interpretation Tool - runnable demo (JAH-ATK157S-000001)
import re
RANK = 1
SIG = True
SAMPLE = 'box start: Begin process\nbox check: Data valid?\nbox done: Store record\nstart -> check\ncheck -> done: yes'
nodes, edges = {}, []
for line in SAMPLE.strip().split("\n"):
    line = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r"box\s+(\w+)\s*:\s*(.+)", line)
    if m: nodes[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip(); continue
    m = re.match(r"(\w+)\s*->\s*(\w+)(?:\s*:\s*(.+))?", line)
    if m: edges.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), (m.group(3) or "").strip()))
print("nodes:", len(nodes), "| edges:", len(edges))
for nid, label in nodes.items():
    outs = [e[1] for e in edges if e[0] == nid]
    print(" [%s] %s -> %s" % (nid, label, outs if outs else "(end)"))
if RANK >= 2:
    roots = [n for n in nodes if not any(e[1] == n for e in edges)]
    print("entry points:", roots)
if RANK >= 3:
    labels = " ".join(nodes.values()).lower()
    decisions = [n for n, l in nodes.items() if "?" in l]
    print("decision nodes:", decisions, "| label vocabulary:", len(set(labels.split())))
if SIG:
    print("Signature lineage stamp: JAH-SIG-DIA-" + "JAH-ATK157S-000001")
print("record:", "JAH-ATK157S-000001", "OK")
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
